name: canvas-lms-mcp-local

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Get the current Canvas user (id, name, login). Cheapest way to verify the token works.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Full profile for the current user: bio, avatar, primary email, calendar feed URL.

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.description: User-level Canvas settings (dashboard view, activity stream visibility, comment notifications).

tools.name: check_token_expiry
tools.description: Check whether your Canvas access token is near expiry. Canvas forces expiration on student-role tokens (commonly 30-120 days) and does not warn you. Run this at the start of a term.

tools.name: get_rate_limit_status
tools.description: Report the Canvas rate-limit state observed on the most recent API call. Canvas throttles by cumulative request COST, not request count.

tools.name: list_my_enrollments
tools.description: All enrollments for the current user across courses, including role, section, and grade summary.

tools.name: get_activity_stream
tools.description: Recent activity across all courses: new announcements, discussion replies, grade changes, messages.

tools.name: get_activity_stream_summary
tools.description: Counts of unread items by type. Very cheap. Use before pulling the full stream.

tools.name: list_todo
tools.description: Canvas's own TODO list for the current user: assignments needing submission and items needing grading.

tools.name: get_todo_count
tools.description: Count of TODO items without fetching them. Cheap.

tools.name: list_upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming calendar events and assignments for the current user (Canvas-defined window).

tools.name: get_dashboard_cards
tools.description: Dashboard course cards: exactly the courses Canvas shows you on the homepage, with colors and quick links.

tools.name: list_favorite_courses
tools.description: Courses starred as favorites (these drive the dashboard).

tools.name: add_favorite_course
tools.description: Star a course as a favorite so it appears on your dashboard.

tools.name: remove_favorite_course
tools.description: Unstar a course, removing it from your dashboard.

tools.name: get_communication_channels
tools.description: Notification delivery channels (email addresses, SMS, push) registered on your account.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Notification preferences for one communication channel (how often Canvas emails you about each event type).

tools.name: get_my_page_views
tools.description: Your own Canvas page view history. Useful for proving you accessed material on a given date.

tools.name: list_content_shares
tools.description: Course content other users have shared directly with you.

tools.name: get_custom_data
tools.description: Read arbitrary key-value data stored on your Canvas account. Canvas provides this as a free per-user store; useful for persisting notes or state server-side.

tools.name: set_custom_data
tools.description: Write arbitrary key-value data to your Canvas account custom-data store.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: Your saved Canvas bookmarks.

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Save a Canvas bookmark pointing at a course URL.

tools.name: delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete a saved Canvas bookmark.

tools.name: list_my_observees
tools.description: Users you observe (linked students). Mostly relevant for parent/observer accounts.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List courses you are enrolled in. By default only active ones; pass include_concluded to see finished terms. Includes current grade when available.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Full detail for one course including term, syllabus and public description.

tools.name: get_syllabus
tools.description: Fetch a course syllabus as readable text (Canvas stores it as HTML).

tools.name: get_course_settings
tools.description: Course-level settings (late policy visibility, syllabus public, hide final grades, grading standard toggles).

tools.name: list_course_tabs
tools.description: Which navigation tabs exist and are visible in a course. Tells you if Quizzes/Files/Pages are even enabled before you query them.

tools.name: get_course_activity_stream
tools.description: Recent activity scoped to a single course.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Sections within a course, including your own enrollment section.

tools.name: list_course_users
tools.description: People in a course. Visibility depends on institution privacy settings; often limited or blocked for student tokens.

tools.name: get_user_in_course
tools.description: Details for one user within a course context.

tools.name: get_course_permissions
tools.description: What your token is actually allowed to do in this course. Call this before attempting any write to avoid half-completed actions.

tools.name: list_course_nicknames
tools.description: Personal nicknames you have set for courses (only you see these).

tools.name: set_course_nickname
tools.description: Rename a course for yourself only. Does not affect anyone else.

tools.name: remove_course_nickname
tools.description: Remove a personal course nickname, restoring the official name.

tools.name: get_course_progress
tools.description: Module completion progress for self-paced courses. Returns 404 if the course has no module requirements.

tools.name: list_todo_for_course
tools.description: TODO items scoped to one course.

tools.name: list_blackout_dates
tools.description: Blackout dates for a course (no-work days used by course pacing).

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: All assignments in a course with due dates, point values, and your submission status.

tools.name: get_assignment
tools.description: Full detail for one assignment including the description/prompt and rubric.

tools.name: list_assignment_groups
tools.description: Assignment groups WITH their grade weights. Required to understand how your final grade is actually computed.

tools.name: get_assignment_group
tools.description: One assignment group with its weight and drop rules.

tools.name: list_assignment_overrides
tools.description: Due-date overrides on an assignment (extensions granted to sections, groups, or individuals).

tools.name: get_my_override
tools.description: The effective due/lock/unlock dates that apply to YOU for an assignment, accounting for section overrides.

tools.name: get_assignment_dates
tools.description: Compact due/lock/unlock date list for every assignment in a course.

tools.name: get_score_statistics
tools.description: Class mean/min/max/quartiles for an assignment. Canvas only exposes this once enough students have submitted and the instructor has not disabled it.

tools.name: get_late_policy
tools.description: The course late policy: exact percentage deducted per late interval, and the floor for missing submissions.

tools.name: list_missing_submissions
tools.description: Every assignment across ALL courses that Canvas considers missing. Single cross-course call, far cheaper than looping courses.

tools.name: list_upcoming_assignments
tools.description: Assignments due within the next N days across all active courses, sorted soonest-first. Uses the Planner feed, which is the same source the Canvas student dashboard uses.

tools.name: list_overdue_assignments
tools.description: Assignments past their due date that you have not submitted, across all active courses.

tools.name: get_my_submission
tools.description: Your submission for one assignment: score, grade, lateness, deductions, attachments, and instructor comments.

tools.name: list_my_submissions
tools.description: All of your submissions in a course at once, with scores and status.

tools.name: get_submission_summary
tools.description: Aggregate graded/ungraded/not-submitted counts for an assignment.

tools.name: get_submission_history
tools.description: All prior attempts/versions of your submission for an assignment.

tools.name: list_submission_attachments
tools.description: Files attached to your submission for an assignment.

tools.name: get_originality_report
tools.description: Plagiarism/originality score for a submission, if Turnitin or a similar tool is enabled on the assignment.

tools.name: get_rubric_assessment
tools.description: The rubric scoring your instructor applied to your submission, criterion by criterion with comments.

tools.name: list_submission_comments
tools.description: Instructor feedback comments on your submission. Comments are authored by other people and are returned provenance-fenced.

tools.name: mark_submission_read
tools.description: Mark your submission (and its new grade/comments) as read, clearing the unread badge.

tools.name: submit_assignment_text
tools.description: Submit a text-entry assignment. The text is uploaded exactly as given; this tool does not author anything. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: submit_assignment_url
tools.description: Submit a URL for a website-submission assignment. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: submit_assignment_file
tools.description: Upload a local file and submit it to an assignment. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local file

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: upload_submission_file
tools.description: Upload a file into an assignment submission slot WITHOUT submitting. Returns a file_id you can submit later.

tools.name: post_submission_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on your own submission. Your instructor sees this. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: upload_comment_attachment
tools.description: Upload a file to attach to a submission comment.

tools.name: download_submission_attachment
tools.description: Download a file attached to one of your submissions to local disk.

tools.name: get_all_grades
tools.description: Current and final grades for every active course in one call, including unposted variants where visible.

tools.name: get_course_grade_breakdown
tools.description: Full grade math for one course: every assignment group with its weight, your points earned vs possible per group, and the weighted contribution of each. This is what Canvas shows you, decomposed.

tools.name: what_if_grade
tools.description: Enter a hypothetical score on an assignment and get your fully recalculated course grade back, with assignment-group weighting and drop rules applied by Canvas itself. This writes a student-only what-if score to the submission; it is NOT a real grade and nobody else sees it. Reverse with reset_what_if_grades. Canvas flags this as expensive, so use it sparingly.

tools.name: reset_what_if_grades
tools.description: Clear all what-if scores in a course and recalculate back to your real grades.

tools.name: get_grading_standard
tools.description: The letter-grade cutoff scheme for a course (what percentage is an A-, B+, etc).

tools.name: list_grading_periods
tools.description: Grading periods for a course (used where grades are split by term segment).

tools.name: get_my_assignment_analytics
tools.description: Per-assignment analytics for you: your score against the class MEDIAN, min and max, plus on-time status. One of the most useful endpoints Canvas exposes to students.

tools.name: get_my_activity_analytics
tools.description: Your page views and participations in a course, bucketed by day.

tools.name: get_my_communication_analytics
tools.description: Message volume between you and the instructor in a course, by day.

tools.name: get_unposted_grades
tools.description: Scores that exist but have not been posted/released, where your enrollment exposes them.

tools.name: compute_needed_score
tools.description: Pure math, no writes: given a target final percentage, compute what average you need on remaining ungraded work in a course. Accounts for assignment-group weighting.

tools.name: grade_impact_ranking
tools.description: Rank ungraded/upcoming assignments in a course by how much each point moves your final grade. Tells you where effort actually pays.

tools.name: get_grade_trend
tools.description: Chronological list of graded assignments in a course with a running average, showing whether your grade is climbing or sliding.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: Quizzes in a course with due dates, time limits, attempt allowances and point values.

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.description: Full detail for one quiz including instructions, timing rules and result visibility settings.

tools.name: get_my_quiz_submission
tools.description: Your submission record for a quiz: score, attempt number, state, and timing.

tools.name: list_my_quiz_submissions
tools.description: All of your attempts on a quiz, with scores per attempt.

tools.name: get_quiz_submission_time
tools.description: Time remaining and end time on an in-progress timed quiz attempt.

tools.name: list_quiz_questions
tools.description: Questions on a quiz. Canvas hides these from students unless the quiz is completed and the instructor allows reviewing answers, so this commonly returns 401/empty. Intended for post-hoc review of a graded quiz.

tools.name: get_quiz_extensions
tools.description: Extra time or extra attempts granted to you on a quiz (accommodations).

tools.name: get_quiz_ip_filters
tools.description: IP address restrictions on a quiz (used for proctored/lab-only exams).

tools.name: get_quiz_assignment_overrides
tools.description: Per-section or per-student due date overrides on quizzes in a course.

tools.name: list_new_quizzes
tools.description: New Quizzes (Quiz LTI) in a course. New Quizzes is a separate service from Classic Quizzes and may not be enabled at your institution.

tools.name: get_new_quiz
tools.description: Detail for a New Quizzes assessment via the Quiz LTI API path.

tools.name: get_new_quiz_items
tools.description: Items (questions) in a New Quizzes assessment. Requires instructor scope at most institutions.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Discussion topics in a course, with unread counts and whether an initial post is required before you can see replies.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: One discussion topic with its prompt. Body is provenance-fenced.

tools.name: get_full_topic_view
tools.description: Fetch an ENTIRE discussion thread (all entries and nested replies) in a single request instead of paginating. Much cheaper on rate limits. All participant text is provenance-fenced because classmates wrote it.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: Top-level entries in a discussion topic (paginated form).

tools.name: list_entry_replies
tools.description: Replies nested under one discussion entry.

tools.name: post_entry
tools.description: Post a new top-level entry to a course discussion. Visible to the whole class. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: reply_to_entry
tools.description: Reply to a specific discussion entry. Visible to the whole class. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: edit_my_entry
tools.description: Edit one of your own discussion entries, if the course allows editing. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: delete_my_entry
tools.description: Delete one of your own discussion entries. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: rate_entry
tools.description: Like/rate a discussion entry, where the instructor enabled rating.

tools.name: mark_topic_read
tools.description: Mark a discussion topic as read.

tools.name: mark_all_entries_read
tools.description: Mark every entry in a discussion topic as read.

tools.name: mark_entry_read
tools.description: Mark one discussion entry as read.

tools.name: subscribe_topic
tools.description: Subscribe to a discussion topic to get notified of replies.

tools.name: unsubscribe_topic
tools.description: Unsubscribe from a discussion topic.

tools.name: list_announcements
tools.description: Announcements across one or many courses in a single call. Announcement bodies are provenance-fenced.

course_ids.description: Course IDs; omit for all active courses

tools.name: get_unread_discussion_count
tools.description: Unread discussion counts per topic in a course. Cheap.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Canvas Inbox conversations. Scope: inbox, unread, starred, archived, sent.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Full message thread for one conversation. All message bodies are provenance-fenced; other people wrote them.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a new Canvas Inbox message, e.g. to a professor. Use find_recipients first to get recipient IDs. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

separate_threads.description: Send individually rather than as a group thread

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Reply within an existing Canvas Inbox conversation. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: find_recipients
tools.description: Search for people you are allowed to message. Returns the user IDs required by send_message.

tools.name: add_recipients
tools.description: Add more people to an existing conversation thread. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.description: Mark a conversation as read.

tools.name: mark_conversation_unread
tools.description: Mark a conversation as unread.

tools.name: star_conversation
tools.description: Star a conversation.

tools.name: unstar_conversation
tools.description: Unstar a conversation.

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive a conversation, removing it from the inbox view.

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Delete a conversation from your inbox. This does not delete it for the other participants. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: get_unread_conversation_count
tools.description: Number of unread Inbox messages. Very cheap.

tools.name: batch_update_conversations
tools.description: Apply one action (mark read, archive, star, destroy) to many conversations at once. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Calendar events or assignment due dates in a date range. Set type=assignment to get due dates as calendar items.

tools.name: get_calendar_event
tools.description: Detail for one calendar event.

tools.name: create_personal_event
tools.description: Create a personal calendar event on your own Canvas calendar.

tools.name: update_calendar_event
tools.description: Update a calendar event you own.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event you own. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_appointment_groups
tools.description: Appointment groups you can sign up for. This is how office hours and advising slots are published.

tools.name: get_appointment_group
tools.description: Detail for one appointment group, including individual time slots and remaining capacity.

tools.name: reserve_appointment_slot
tools.description: Book an office hours or advising slot. Visible to the instructor. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancel an appointment reservation you made. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_my_reservations
tools.description: Appointment slots you have currently reserved.

tools.name: get_course_pace
tools.description: Course pacing plan for self-paced courses (per-module day allocations).

tools.name: list_course_files
tools.description: Files published in a course (slides, readings, handouts).

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: Folders in a course file tree.

tools.name: get_folder
tools.description: Detail for one folder.

tools.name: get_folder_tree
tools.description: Recursive folder+file tree for a course, rendered as an indented outline. Good first look at what material exists.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Metadata for one file.

tools.name: get_file_public_url
tools.description: Get a temporary public download URL for a file.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a Canvas file to local disk.

tools.name: list_my_files
tools.description: Files in your personal Canvas storage.

tools.name: upload_to_my_files
tools.description: Upload a local file into your personal Canvas file storage.

tools.name: get_storage_quota
tools.description: Your personal Canvas storage quota and how much is used.

tools.name: delete_my_file
tools.description: Delete a file from your personal Canvas storage. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in your personal Canvas storage.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Wiki pages in a course.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read a course page as text. Page bodies are HTML and are converted and provenance-fenced.

tools.name: list_page_revisions
tools.description: Revision history for a course page.

tools.name: get_page_revision
tools.description: One historical revision of a course page.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: Course modules with completion state and prerequisites.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: One module with its items.

tools.name: list_module_items
tools.description: Items in a module with your completion requirement status.

tools.name: get_module_item
tools.description: One module item.

tools.name: mark_module_item_done
tools.description: Mark a module item as done, satisfying a must_mark_done completion requirement.

tools.name: mark_module_item_read
tools.description: Mark a module item as viewed, satisfying a must_view completion requirement.

tools.name: select_mastery_path
tools.description: Choose a mastery path branch on a module item, where conditional release is enabled. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: get_module_item_sequence
tools.description: Previous/next navigation around a piece of content, showing where it sits in the module sequence.

tools.name: list_media_objects
tools.description: Media objects (recorded lectures, video/audio) in a course.

tools.name: get_media_captions
tools.description: List caption/subtitle tracks available on a recorded lecture. Captions are the closest thing Canvas gives you to a lecture transcript.

tools.name: download_media_captions
tools.description: Download a lecture caption track as text and save it locally. Turns a recorded lecture into a readable transcript.

track_id.description: Defaults to the first English track

tools.name: create_content_export
tools.description: Trigger a full course export (.imscc common cartridge). Useful for archiving a course before term-end access is revoked. Returns a progress URL; poll with get_content_export.

tools.name: get_content_export
tools.description: Check the status of a course export and get the download URL once ready.

tools.name: list_external_tools
tools.description: LTI external tools available in a course (publisher platforms, proctoring, third-party apps).

tools.name: get_tool_launch_url
tools.description: Get a sessionless launch URL for an LTI tool, so you can open it directly.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: Web conferences in a course (BigBlueButton, Zoom integrations).

tools.name: list_collaborations
tools.description: Collaborative documents in a course (Google Docs / Office integrations).

tools.name: list_my_groups
tools.description: Student groups you belong to across all courses.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Detail for one group.

tools.name: list_group_members
tools.description: Members of a group.

tools.name: list_group_discussions
tools.description: Discussion topics inside a group workspace.

tools.name: list_group_files
tools.description: Files in a group workspace.

tools.name: list_group_pages
tools.description: Wiki pages in a group workspace.

tools.name: post_group_discussion
tools.description: Post to a discussion inside a group workspace. Visible to your groupmates. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_group_categories
tools.description: Group categories/sets defined in a course.

tools.name: join_group
tools.description: Join a self-signup group. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: leave_group
tools.description: Leave a group you are a member of. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: get_group_activity_stream
tools.description: Recent activity in a group workspace.

tools.name: list_rubrics
tools.description: Rubrics defined in a course.

tools.name: get_rubric
tools.description: Full rubric with every criterion, rating level and point value. Read this BEFORE writing an assignment to know how it will be scored.

tools.name: get_my_rubric_assessment
tools.description: How a rubric was applied to your submission, criterion by criterion.

tools.name: list_my_peer_reviews
tools.description: Peer reviews assigned to YOU that still need completing. Checks both the direct assignment endpoint and the Planner feed, because the direct endpoint alone misses items.

course_id.description: Omit to check all active courses

tools.name: get_peer_review_assignment
tools.description: Peer review records on a specific assignment.

tools.name: submit_peer_review
tools.description: Submit a peer review of a classmate: a comment and optionally a rubric assessment. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

student_id.description: The student whose work you are reviewing

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_outcomes
tools.description: Learning outcomes linked to a course.

tools.name: get_outcome
tools.description: Detail for one learning outcome including its mastery scale.

tools.name: list_outcome_groups
tools.description: Outcome group hierarchy in a course.

tools.name: get_my_outcome_results
tools.description: Your mastery results against course learning outcomes.

tools.name: get_outcome_rollup
tools.description: Rolled-up mastery scores per outcome for you.

tools.name: smart_search
tools.description: Canvas's meaning-based (embedding) search over course content. This is a BETA Canvas feature with limited availability, so it frequently returns 404. Falls back to a plain keyword scan when unavailable.

tools.name: search_course_content
tools.description: Keyword search across a course: pages, assignments, announcements and discussion titles/bodies. Works everywhere, unlike smart_search.

tools.name: grep_all_courses
tools.description: Keyword search across every active course at once. Expensive in API calls; prefer search_course_content when you know the course.

tools.name: get_week_ahead
tools.description: One-call view of the coming week: everything due, anything already missing, unread announcements, and unread inbox count. Merges the Planner feed, missing submissions, calendar and inbox.

tools.name: get_workload_forecast
tools.description: Points at stake per week over the next N weeks, so you can see crunch weeks before they hit.

tools.name: get_all_unread
tools.description: Every unread thing in one call: inbox messages, discussion replies, announcements and activity stream items.

tools.name: course_health_check
tools.description: Complete status of one course: current grade, what is missing, what is ungraded, what is coming up, and unread discussions.

tools.name: semester_snapshot
tools.description: Everything, everywhere, in one call: every active course with its grade, missing work, upcoming deadlines and unread counts. Expensive but comprehensive. Use at the start of a session.

tools.name: diff_since_last_check
tools.description: What changed since a given timestamp: new grades posted, new announcements, new discussion replies, new inbox messages.

tools.name: syllabus_digest
tools.description: Pull a course syllabus and extract anything that looks like a date, percentage weight, or policy sentence. Rough heuristic extraction over the syllabus text.

tools.name: deadline_conflict_check
tools.description: Find days in the next N days where multiple assignments are due, weighted by points, so you can spot pileups early.

tools.name: study_priority_ranking
tools.description: Rank everything upcoming across all courses by a priority score combining grade impact, urgency, and how weak your current standing in that course is. Opinionated, and the formula is shown so you can disagree with it.

tools.name: download_all_course_files
tools.description: Bulk download every file you can access in a course to local disk. Can be a lot of requests and a lot of megabytes.

tools.name: export_course_archive
tools.description: Trigger a full course export, poll until Canvas finishes packaging it, then download the .imscc archive locally. Use before a term ends and access disappears. Can take several minutes.

tools.name: raw_canvas_request
tools.description: Escape hatch: call ANY Canvas API endpoint directly. Covers the entire API surface, including anything this server does not wrap. GET is unrestricted; POST/PUT/DELETE are gated by CANVAS_ALLOW_WRITES and require confirm=true.

paginate.description: Follow Link headers and collect all pages (GET only)

confirm.description: Required for POST/PUT/DELETE

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the tools this server exposes by keyword. Useful because the tool surface is large.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Verify the token, base URL and permissions end to end. Run this first if anything is failing.

tools.name: get_server_config
tools.description: Show how this server is configured and what is enabled, without revealing the token.
